rules.rule: A call of try in a JSON string template is an evaluation error when its arguments aren't valid native syntax, which try doesn't catch, or when none of them succeeds

try and can can be called in JSON string templates with native expressions as their arguments, evaluated with the variables in scope: a call that is the whole template gives its value unwrapped, such as can's bool, one beside other text is converted to a string, and calls also work in property names and in an if directive's condition
